title: PVL: Rookie Lams Lamina off to unfamiliar start with Galeries

blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — Galeries Tower’s No. 1 overall pick Lams Lamina was welcomed by a big change in the pros after she started her Premier Volleyball League (PVL) career with back-to-back losses in the All-Filipino Conference Siklab Series. Facing Alas Pilipinas setter and idol Jia De Guzman, Lamina and the High Risers scored a big first-set win over the Creamline Cool Smashers, but they couldn’t sustain their impressive start as the 11-time champion team still prevailed, 25-19, 25-17, 23-25, 20-25, 15-12, on Saturday at FilOil EcoOil Centre in San Juan City. “Every game is a big deal for me, actually.
